```
// zhxstudio — surfgobbypass
package com.zhx.studiotool;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import java.util.Locale;

public final class AppLanguage {
    private AppLanguage() {}
    public static Context wrap(Context context) {
        String code = context.getSharedPreferences("settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getString("language", "ru");
        Configuration configuration = new Configuration(context.getResources().getConfiguration());
        configuration.setLocale(Locale.forLanguageTag(code));
        return context.createConfigurationContext(configuration);
    }
    public static String text(Context context, int id) { return wrap(context).getString(id); }
}
```

```
// zhxstudio — surfgobbypass
package com.zhx.studiotool;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.ClipData;
import android.content.ClipboardManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.*;
import rikka.shizuku.Shizuku;

public final class MainActivity extends Activity {
    private SharedPreferences prefs;
    private boolean waitingOverlay;
    private final Shizuku.OnRequestPermissionResultListener listener = (code, result) -> {
        if (code == 100) runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (result == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) startOverlay();
            else toast(getString(R.string.denied_shizuku));
        });
    };
    @Override protected void attachBaseContext(Context base) { super.attachBaseContext(AppLanguage.wrap(base)); }
    @Override public void onCreate(Bundle state) {
        super.onCreate(state);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main);
        prefs = getSharedPreferences("settings", MODE_PRIVATE);
        waitingOverlay = state != null && state.getBoolean("waitingOverlay");
        View root = findViewById(R.id.root);
        root.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener((v, insets) -> {
            v.setPadding(insets.getSystemWindowInsetLeft(), insets.getSystemWindowInsetTop(),
                    insets.getSystemWindowInsetRight(), insets.getSystemWindowInsetBottom());
            return insets;
        });
        root.requestApplyInsets();
        Shizuku.addRequestPermissionResultListener(listener);
        Spinner languages = findViewById(R.id.languages);
        String[] codes = {"ru", "en", "sr"};
        ArrayAdapter<String> adapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item,
                new String[]{"Русский", "English", "Српски"});
        adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
        languages.setAdapter(adapter);
        String selected = prefs.getString("language", "ru");
        languages.setSelection("en".equals(selected) ? 1 : "sr".equals(selected) ? 2 : 0);
        languages.setOnItemSelectedListener(new AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
            @Override public void onItemSelected(AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id) {
                if (!codes[position].equals(prefs.getString("language", "ru"))) {
                    prefs.edit().putString("language", codes[position]).apply();
                    recreate();
                }
            }
            @Override public void onNothingSelected(AdapterView<?> parent) {}
        });
        RadioGroup methods = findViewById(R.id.methods);
        methods.check("root".equals(prefs.getString("method", "shizuku")) ? R.id.root_method : R.id.shizuku_method);
        methods.setOnCheckedChangeListener((group, id) -> prefs.edit().putString("method",
                id == R.id.root_method ? "root" : "shizuku").apply());
        if (!prefs.contains("method")) prefs.edit().putString("method", "shizuku").apply();
        SeekBar size = findViewById(R.id.size);
        TextView label = findViewById(R.id.size_label);
        int value = prefs.getInt("size", 64);
        size.setProgress(value - 48);
        label.setText(getString(R.string.size, value));
        size.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar bar, int progress, boolean user) {
                label.setText(getString(R.string.size, progress + 48));
                prefs.edit().putInt("size", progress + 48).apply();
            }
            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar) {}
            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar bar) {}
        });
        findViewById(R.id.start).setOnClickListener(v -> startOverlay());
        findViewById(R.id.stop).setOnClickListener(v -> stopService(new Intent(this, OverlayService.class)));
        findViewById(R.id.diagnostics).setOnClickListener(v -> {
            String error = prefs.getString("last_error", "");
            String detail = "Android " + Build.VERSION.RELEASE + " (API " + Build.VERSION.SDK_INT + ")\n"
                    + "Target: " + ShellRunner.TARGET_PACKAGE + "\n"
                    + (error.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.no_error) : error);
            new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle(R.string.diagnostics).setMessage(detail)
                    .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                    .setNeutralButton(R.string.copy, (dialog, which) -> getSystemService(ClipboardManager.class)
                            .setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("surfgobbypass", detail))).show();
        });
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 && checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            requestPermissions(new String[]{Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS}, 101);
        }
    }
    private void startOverlay() {
        try {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                waitingOverlay = true;
                startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                        Uri.parse("package:" + getPackageName())));
                return;
            }
            if ("shizuku".equals(prefs.getString("method", "shizuku"))) {
                if (!Shizuku.pingBinder() || Shizuku.getVersion() < 12) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.require_shizuku)); return;
                }
                if (Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    if (Shizuku.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale()) toast(getString(R.string.grant_shizuku));
                    else Shizuku.requestPermission(100);
                    return;
                }
            }
            startForegroundService(new Intent(this, OverlayService.class));
        } catch (RuntimeException e) { toast(getString(R.string.error) + ": " + e.getMessage()); }
    }
    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (waitingOverlay) {
            waitingOverlay = false;
            if (Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) startOverlay();
            else toast(getString(R.string.overlay_denied));
        }
    }
    @Override protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle state) {
        state.putBoolean("waitingOverlay", waitingOverlay);
        super.onSaveInstanceState(state);
    }
    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        Shizuku.removeRequestPermissionResultListener(listener);
        super.onDestroy();
    }
    private void toast(String message) { Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); }
}
```

### app/src/main/java/com/zhx/studiotool/OverlayService.java
```
// zhxstudio — surfgobbypass
package com.zhx.studiotool;

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.ServiceConnection;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.PixelFormat;
import android.graphics.Point;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.ViewConfiguration;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.Toast;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import rikka.shizuku.Shizuku;

public final class OverlayService extends Service
        implements SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener {
    private static final String STOP = "com.zhx.studiotool.STOP";
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private WindowManager windows;
    private WindowManager.LayoutParams params;
    private SharedPreferences prefs;
    private Button button;
    private boolean destroyed, busy, bound, pending;
    private IShellService remote;
    private Shizuku.UserServiceArgs userArgs;
    private float downX, downY;
    private int initialX, initialY;
    private boolean dragging;

    private final Runnable bindTimeout = () -> {
        boolean waiting = pending;
        pending = false;
        disconnect();
        if (waiting) finish(t(R.string.bind_timeout));
    };

    private final ServiceConnection connection = new ServiceConnection() {
        @Override public void onServiceConnected(ComponentName name, IBinder binder) {
            main.post(() -> {
                if (destroyed || !bound) return;
                remote = IShellService.Stub.asInterface(binder);
                main.removeCallbacks(bindTimeout);
                if (pending) {
                    pending = false;
                    execute("shizuku");
                }
            });
        }
        @Override public void onServiceDisconnected(ComponentName name) {
            main.post(() -> {
                disconnect();
                if (pending) {
                    pending = false;
                    main.removeCallbacks(bindTimeout);
                    finish(t(R.string.disconnected));
                }
            });
        }
    };

    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();
        prefs = getSharedPreferences("settings", MODE_PRIVATE);
        windows = getSystemService(WindowManager.class);
        userArgs = new Shizuku.UserServiceArgs(new ComponentName(this, ShellService.class))
                .daemon(false).processNameSuffix("shell").version(7);
        updateNotification();
        prefs.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(this);
    }

    private String t(int id) { return AppLanguage.text(this, id); }

    private void updateNotification() {
        NotificationManager manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);
        manager.createNotificationChannel(new NotificationChannel("overlay", t(R.string.channel),
                NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW));
        PendingIntent open = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0, new Intent(this, MainActivity.class),
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        PendingIntent stop = PendingIntent.getService(this, 1,
                new Intent(this, OverlayService.class).setAction(STOP),
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE);
        Notification notification = new Notification.Builder(this, "overlay")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_view)
                .setContentTitle(t(R.string.app_name)).setContentText(t(R.string.notification))
                .setContentIntent(open).setOngoing(true)
                .addAction(new Notification.Action.Builder(null, t(R.string.stop), stop).build()).build();
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
            startForeground(1, notification, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_SPECIAL_USE);
        } else startForeground(1, notification);
    }

    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int id) {
        if ((intent != null && STOP.equals(intent.getAction())) || !Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
            stopSelf();
            return START_NOT_STICKY;
        }
        if (button == null) {
            try { createButton(); }
            catch (RuntimeException e) { toast(t(R.string.error) + ": " + e.getMessage()); stopSelf(); }
        }
        warmShizuku();
        warmRoot();
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }

    private void warmShizuku() {
        if (destroyed || bound || !"shizuku".equals(prefs.getString("method", "root"))) return;
        try {
            if (Shizuku.pingBinder() && Shizuku.getVersion() >= 12
                    && Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                bindShizuku();
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            disconnect();
            Log.w("ZHX", "Shizuku preconnect failed", e);
        }
    }

    private void warmRoot() {
        if (!destroyed && "root".equals(prefs.getString("method", "shizuku"))) {
            executor.execute(() -> { if (!destroyed) ShellRunner.prepare(true); });
        }
    }

    private void bindShizuku() {
        bound = true;
        main.removeCallbacks(bindTimeout);
        main.postDelayed(bindTimeout, 15000);
        Shizuku.bindUserService(userArgs, connection);
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    private void createButton() {
        button = new Button(this);
        button.setText("B");
        button.setTextSize(22);
        button.setTextColor(Color.WHITE);
        button.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        button.setPadding(0, 0, 0, 0);
        button.setMinWidth(0);
        button.setMinHeight(0);
        button.setContentDescription("Bypass Surf GO");
        GradientDrawable background = new GradientDrawable();
        background.setShape(GradientDrawable.OVAL);
        background.setColor(Color.rgb(21, 101, 192));
        button.setBackground(background);
        int size = dp(prefs.getInt("size", 64));
        params = new WindowManager.LayoutParams(size, size,
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY,
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE
                        | WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL,
                PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT);
        params.gravity = Gravity.TOP | Gravity.LEFT;
        params.x = dp(16);
        params.y = dp(120);
        button.setOnClickListener(v -> click());
        int slop = ViewConfiguration.get(this).getScaledTouchSlop();
        button.setOnTouchListener((view, event) -> {
            switch (event.getActionMasked()) {
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                    downX = event.getRawX(); downY = event.getRawY();
                    initialX = params.x; initialY = params.y; dragging = false;
                    return true;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                    float dx = event.getRawX() - downX, dy = event.getRawY() - downY;
                    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > slop) dragging = true;
                    if (dragging) {
                        params.x = initialX + Math.round(dx);
                        params.y = initialY + Math.round(dy);
                        updateWindow();
                    }
                    return true;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                    if (!dragging) view.performClick();
                    return true;
                case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                    dragging = false;
                    return true;
                default: return true;
            }
        });
        windows.addView(button, params);
    }

    private void click() {
        if (busy || destroyed) return;
        busy = true;
        button.setAlpha(0.55f);
        String method = prefs.getString("method", "root");
        if (!"shizuku".equals(method)) { execute(method); return; }
        try {
            if (!Shizuku.pingBinder() || Shizuku.getVersion() < 12
                    || Shizuku.checkSelfPermission() != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                finish(t(R.string.shizuku_access));
                return;
            }
            if (remote != null && remote.asBinder().isBinderAlive()) {
                execute(method);
            } else {
                pending = true;
                if (!bound) bindShizuku();
                else if (remote != null) {
                    disconnect();
                    bindShizuku();
                }
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            pending = false;
            main.removeCallbacks(bindTimeout);
            disconnect();
            finish(e.toString());
        }
    }

    private void execute(String method) {
        IShellService service = remote;
        executor.execute(() -> {
            String result;
            try {
                result = "shizuku".equals(method)
                        ? (service == null ? t(R.string.disconnected) : service.execute())
                        : ShellRunner.run("root".equals(method));
                if (result == null) result = t(R.string.empty_reply);
            } catch (Exception e) { result = e.toString(); }
            String message = result;
            main.post(() -> finish(message));
        });
    }

    private void finish(String error) {
        if (destroyed) return;
        busy = false;
        if (button != null) button.setAlpha(1f);
        prefs.edit().putString("last_error", error).apply();
        if (error.isEmpty()) toast(t(R.string.success));
        else {
            Log.e("ZHX", error);
            if ("TIMEOUT".equals(error)) error = t(R.string.command_timeout);
            else if ("CANCELLED".equals(error)) error = t(R.string.cancelled);
            else if (error.startsWith("LAUNCH_FAILED:")) error = t(R.string.launch_failed) + error.substring("LAUNCH_FAILED:".length());
            else if (error.startsWith("TARGET_NOT_FOUND:")) error = t(R.string.target_not_found);
            else if (error.startsWith("HOME_FAILED:")) error = t(R.string.home_failed);
            toast(t(R.string.error) + ": " + error.substring(0, Math.min(error.length(), 180)));
        }
    }

    private void toast(String message) {
        Toast toast = Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 30) toast.setGravity(Gravity.BOTTOM | Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL, 0, dp(64));
        toast.show();
    }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return Math.round(value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    private void updateWindow() {
        if (button == null || !button.isAttachedToWindow()) return;
        Point display = new Point();
        windows.getDefaultDisplay().getSize(display);
        params.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(params.x, Math.max(0, display.x - params.width)));
        params.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(params.y, Math.max(0, display.y - params.height)));
        try { windows.updateViewLayout(button, params); }
        catch (RuntimeException e) { stopSelf(); }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSharedPreferenceChanged(SharedPreferences preferences, String key) {
        if ("language".equals(key)) updateNotification();
        if ("method".equals(key)) { warmShizuku(); warmRoot(); }
        if ("size".equals(key) && params != null) {
            params.width = params.height = dp(preferences.getInt("size", 64));
            updateWindow();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration configuration) {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(configuration);
        updateWindow();
    }

    private void disconnect() {
        main.removeCallbacks(bindTimeout);
        remote = null;
        if (bound) {
            bound = false;
            try { Shizuku.unbindUserService(userArgs, connection, true); }
            catch (RuntimeException ignored) { /* Shizuku may already have stopped. */ }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true;
        main.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        prefs.unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(this);
        executor.shutdownNow();
        ShellRunner.close();
        disconnect();
        if (button != null && button.isAttachedToWindow()) windows.removeView(button);
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE);
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }
}
```

### app/src/main/java/com/zhx/studiotool/ShellReplies.java
```
// zhxstudio — Android shell output handling, shared by Root and Shizuku.
package com.zhx.studiotool;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

final class ShellReplies {
    private ShellReplies() {}
    static boolean accepted(int code, String output) {
        if (code != 0) return false;
        String text = output.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return !Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*(error\\b|exception\\b|failure\\b)").matcher(text).find()
                && !Pattern.compile("\\b[\\w.$]*exception\\b").matcher(text).find() && !text.contains("permission denial")
                && !text.contains("permission denied") && !text.contains("unable to resolve")
                && !text.contains("status: timeout") && !text.contains("being kept for the user")
                && !text.contains("should be handled by the caller");
    }
    static String component(String output, String targetPackage) {
        Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*(" + Pattern.quote(targetPackage)
                + "/[A-Za-z0-9_.$]+)\\s*$").matcher(output);
        return matcher.find() ? matcher.group(1) : null;
    }
    static String failure(String stage, int code, String output) {
        return stage + ": exit=" + code + "\n" + output.trim();
    }
}
```

### app/src/main/java/com/zhx/studiotool/ShellRunner.java
```
// zhxstudio — surfgobbypass: persistent privileged shell, no sleep and no force-stop.
package com.zhx.studiotool;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public final class ShellRunner {
    public static final String TARGET_PACKAGE = "com.KotGames.SurfGO";
    private static final Object LOCK = new Object();
    private static volatile Session session;
    private ShellRunner() {}

    public static String prepare(boolean root) {
        synchronized (LOCK) {
            try { return resolveLauncher(ensureSession(root)); }
            catch (InterruptedException e) { close(); Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return "CANCELLED"; }
            catch (Exception e) { close(); return e.toString(); }
        }
    }
    public static String run(boolean root) {
        synchronized (LOCK) {
            try {
                Session shell = ensureSession(root);
                String resolutionError = resolveLauncher(shell);
                if (!resolutionError.isEmpty()) return resolutionError;
                Result home = shell.command("input keyevent 3", 5000);
                if (!ShellReplies.accepted(home.code, home.output)) {
                    Result fallback = shell.command("am start --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN"
                            + " -c android.intent.category.HOME", 5000);
                    if (!ShellReplies.accepted(fallback.code, fallback.output)) {
                        return ShellReplies.failure("HOME_FAILED", home.code, home.output)
                                + "\n" + ShellReplies.failure("HOME_FALLBACK", fallback.code, fallback.output);
                    }
                }
                Result result = shell.command("am start --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN"
                        + " -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -f 0x10200000 -n '"
                        + shell.launchComponent + "'", 10000);
                if (ShellReplies.accepted(result.code, result.output)) return "";
                shell.launchComponent = null;
                return ShellReplies.failure("LAUNCH_FAILED", result.code, result.output);
            } catch (TimeoutException e) {
                close(); return "TIMEOUT";
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                close(); Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return "CANCELLED";
            } catch (Exception e) { close(); return e.toString(); }
        }
    }
    private static String resolveLauncher(Session shell) throws Exception {
        if (shell.launchComponent != null) return "";
        String query = " resolve-activity --brief --user current -a android.intent.action.MAIN"
                + " -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -p " + TARGET_PACKAGE;
        Result result = shell.command("cmd package" + query, 10000);
        String component = result.code == 0 ? ShellReplies.component(result.output, TARGET_PACKAGE) : null;
        if (component == null) {
            Result fallback = shell.command("pm" + query, 10000);
            component = fallback.code == 0 ? ShellReplies.component(fallback.output, TARGET_PACKAGE) : null;
            if (component == null) return "TARGET_NOT_FOUND: " + TARGET_PACKAGE + "\n"
                    + ShellReplies.failure("RESOLVE", result.code, result.output) + "\n"
                    + ShellReplies.failure("RESOLVE_FALLBACK", fallback.code, fallback.output);
        }
        shell.launchComponent = component;
        return "";
    }
    private static Session ensureSession(boolean root) throws Exception {
        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException();
        Session current = session;
        if (current != null && current.root == root && current.process.isAlive()) return current;
        close();
        current = new Session(root);
        session = current;
        Result identity = current.command("id -u", 60000);
        String uid = identity.output.trim();
        if (identity.code != 0 || (root ? !uid.equals("0") : !(uid.equals("0") || uid.equals("2000")))) {
            throw new IOException("Privileged shell access denied");
        }
        return current;
    }
    public static void close() {
        Session current = session;
        session = null;
        if (current != null) current.close();
    }
    private static final class Result {
        final int code;
        final String output;
        Result(int code, String output) { this.code = code; this.output = output; }
    }
    private static final class Session {
        final boolean root;
        final Process process;
        final Writer writer;
        final BlockingQueue<String> lines = new LinkedBlockingQueue<>(256);
        final String eof = "EOF_" + UUID.randomUUID();
        String launchComponent;
        Session(boolean root) throws IOException {
            this.root = root;
            process = new ProcessBuilder(root ? "su" : "sh").redirectErrorStream(true).start();
            writer = new OutputStreamWriter(process.getOutputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Thread drain = new Thread(() -> {
                try (BufferedReader input = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(
                        process.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                    String line;
                    while ((line = input.readLine()) != null) {
                        if (line.length() > 32768 || !lines.offer(line)) { close(); break; }
                    }
                } catch (IOException ignored) { }
                finally { lines.offer(eof); }
            }, "zhxstudio-shell");
            drain.setDaemon(true);
            drain.start();
        }
        Result command(String script, long timeout) throws Exception {
            String marker = "ZHX_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "") + ":";
            writer.write(script + "\nzhx_rc=$?; printf '\\n" + marker + "%s\\n' \"$zhx_rc\"\n");
            writer.flush();
            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeout);
            StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
            while (true) {
                long remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime();
                if (remaining <= 0) throw new TimeoutException();
                String line = lines.poll(remaining, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
                if (line == null) throw new TimeoutException();
                if (line.equals(eof)) throw new IOException("Shell closed");
                if (line.startsWith(marker)) return new Result(
                        Integer.parseInt(line.substring(marker.length()).trim()), output.toString());
                output.append(line).append('\n');
                if (output.length() > 32768) throw new IOException("Shell output limit exceeded");
            }
        }
        void close() { process.destroyForcibly(); lines.clear(); lines.offer(eof); }
    }
}

```
```
@echo off
setlocal
set "APP_HOME=%~dp0"
set "JAVA_EXE=java.exe"
if defined JAVA_HOME set "JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%APP_HOME%init-signing.ps1"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
if not exist "%APP_HOME%gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar" (
    echo Downloading Gradle Wrapper...
    powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120 -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gradle/gradle/v8.12.1/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar' -OutFile (Join-Path $env:APP_HOME 'gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar')"
    if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
)
if "%~1"=="" (
    "%JAVA_EXE%" -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -classpath "%APP_HOME%gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain --project-dir "%APP_HOME%." --no-daemon assembleRelease
) else (
    "%JAVA_EXE%" -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true -classpath "%APP_HOME%gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain --project-dir "%APP_HOME%." %*
)
exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
```

### init-signing.ps1
```
# zhxstudio — keep this key for all future releases.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location $PSScriptRoot
$keyPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'signing/surfgobbypass.jks'
$propertiesPath = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'signing/keystore.properties'
if ((Test-Path $keyPath) -and (Test-Path $propertiesPath)) { exit 0 }
if ((Test-Path $keyPath) -or (Test-Path $propertiesPath)) {
    throw 'Signing files are incomplete. Restore the matching key and keystore.properties from your backup.'
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'signing') | Out-Null
$keytool = 'keytool.exe'
if ($env:JAVA_HOME) { $keytool = Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin/keytool.exe' }
$password = [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
$env:ZHX_SIGNING_PASSWORD = $password
try {
    & $keytool -genkeypair -noprompt -keystore $keyPath -storetype JKS -alias zhxstudio -keyalg RSA -keysize 3072 -validity 10000 -dname 'CN=zhxstudio, OU=surfgobbypass, O=zhxstudio' -storepass:env ZHX_SIGNING_PASSWORD -keypass:env ZHX_SIGNING_PASSWORD
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release key generation failed.' }
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($propertiesPath, "keyAlias=zhxstudio`nstorePassword=$password`nkeyPassword=$password`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
} finally {
    Remove-Item Env:ZHX_SIGNING_PASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
Write-Host 'Release key created. Back up the signing directory; do not publish it.'
```

### tests/ShellRepliesTest.java
```
// zhxstudio — regression tests for Android launch-result variants.
package com.zhx.studiotool;

public final class ShellRepliesTest {
    private static int checks;
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        check(ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Starting: Intent { cmp=com.KotGames.SurfGO/.Main }"), "standard start");
        check(ShellReplies.accepted(0, ""), "successful shell with suppressed output");
        check(ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Warning: Activity not started, its current task has been brought to the front"), "existing task");
        check(ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Warning: Activity not started, intent has been delivered to currently running top-most instance."), "existing activity");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Starting: Intent {}\nError: Activity not started, unable to resolve Intent"), "error even when exit is zero");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Error type 3"), "missing activity");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "java.lang.SecurityException: access denied"), "permission exception");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: invalid intent"), "other exception");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Permission Denial: startActivity"), "permission denial");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(127, "sh: am: not found"), "missing command");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Warning: Activity not started because the current activity is being kept for the user."), "deferred app switch");
        check(!ShellReplies.accepted(0, "Status: timeout"), "launch timeout");
        String pkg = "com.KotGames.SurfGO";
        check((pkg + "/.Main").equals(ShellReplies.component("priority=0\n" + pkg + "/.Main\n", pkg)), "relative launcher");
        check((pkg + "/com.unity3d.player.UnityPlayerActivity").equals(ShellReplies.component(pkg + "/com.unity3d.player.UnityPlayerActivity", pkg)), "external class namespace");
        check(ShellReplies.component("com.other/.Main", pkg) == null, "wrong package rejected");
        check(ShellReplies.component("No activity found", pkg) == null, "no activity");
        check(ShellReplies.component(pkg + "/.Main;reboot", pkg) == null, "invalid component rejected");
        System.out.println(checks + " launch-response checks passed");
    }
    private static void check(boolean value, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!value) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
}

```
